text:
Anya Rivera: Hey — quick RFC follow-up. Proposing a lightweight 'envelope adapter' proxy that can accept legacy client payloads (old SDKs that expect envelope/jsonrpc) and translate them to the v3 body shape at the edge. Would buy us a softer migration path.
Morgan Lee: Sounds useful. What's the envelope shape you have in mind?
Anya Rivera: Example:
```
{
  "env_v":1,
  "meta": {"client":"old-sdk","client_version":"2.x"},
  "payload": {"method":"generate","params": { ... }}
}
```
Samir Patel: Two quick concerns: 1) perf — extra parsing/unwrapping cost. 2) semantics — we must preserve idempotency/streaming semantics for streaming clients.
Tia Gomez: For streaming, adapter should detect streaming flag in meta and proxy raw bytes through without buffering. Otherwise we add latency.
Morgan Lee: Agree. Also need a clear precedence: if client sends both envelope and v3 headers, prefer explicit v3 headers and log a telemetry event for mixed clients.
Anya Rivera: Telemetry: emit a migration tag with tenant_id + client_version to track adoption. Add sampling for noisy tenants.
Samir Patel: How do we ensure we don't silently hide schema breaking changes? I'd add a 'strict mode' toggle per-tenant: default permissive, but can flip to strict to fail fast.
Tia Gomez: Ops: we'll need a canary route and per-tenant opt-in flag. Rollout plan: opt-in canary -> 10% roll -> 50% -> all, with automatic rollback on error-rate spike.
Anya Rivera: Also an escape hatch header `x-unpack-only: true` for support to test behavior without full rollout.
Morgan Lee: Tests: unit for unwrapping, integration for streaming, chaos test where malformed envelopes arrive (should 400). Add end-to-end perf benchmark: p50/p95 before/after.
Samir Patel: Lifetime: this adapter is a temporary bridge. Propose deprecation bump: 6 months of canary/monitoring, then announce 90-day sunset. Add telemetry to auto-alert when usage <1% and then schedule removal.
Tia Gomez: Security: scrub meta fields before forwarding to model infra. No client-supplied runtime flags allowed. Also KMS header passthrough only on allowlist.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: envelope-adapter-v1 -> staging
Morgan Lee: One more: store a per-tenant 'migration cookie' so the adapter can prefer new body shape after it sees a successful v3 request from that tenant. Helps speed cutover.
Anya Rivera: OK — I'll write a short RFC with config knobs (strict_mode, streaming_passthrough, per_tenant_opt_in, migration_cookie_ttl) and a rollout checklist. Any objections?
Samir Patel: No objections. Adding to eng-platform board. :thumbsup:
Tia Gomez: +1
Morgan Lee: +1
Anya Rivera: I'll ping infra for perf budget numbers and schedule a canary next week.
